about:
ICON Injection Molding, Inc. was founded in 2001 in Phoenix, Arizona, by three brothers—Danny, Philip, and Steve Kleitsch. The Kleitsches had worked in their father’s injection molding and tooling shop since the late 1970s, learning tool building and supplier relationships. After their father sold the business, the brothers launched their own family-owned company, naming it ICON after becoming the first custom molder in Arizona to run electric‑hybrid molding machines. Their motto, “Excellence from Art to Part,” was coined early by Danny Kleitsch and still guides the business.

The company provides custom plastic injection molding solutions, including tooling, machining, assembly, and secondary operations. Its facility houses 42 presses ranging from 15 to 720 tons, with capacity for further growth. Capabilities span automation, clean‑room molding, overmolding, rotary (vertical) molding, and custom packaging. A scientific molding approach uses statistical analysis to drive process stability, supported by a quality lab equipped with Keyence 3‑D inspection (to 0.00008 in tolerance), capability studies (CPK), Gage R&R, first‑article inspection, and IQ/OQ/PQ validation. ICON also offers global sourcing through domestic and offshore strategic partnerships, and a campus expansion dubbed “ICON 4” is underway.

ICON serves customers worldwide, from local Phoenix businesses to international clients, delivering both “Made in USA” parts and cost‑effective offshore options. The company works with original equipment manufacturers and supply‑chain partners across diverse sectors, though specific industries are not detailed in public materials.

The founders started ICON to apply a scientific, engineering‑based methodology to molding—preventing problems rather than detecting them. The family‑owned structure, with over 100 combined years of industry experience, underpins a culture of continual improvement and point‑of‑use quality.
